settings.title: Hook Settings
settings.hook_pacman_note: Automatically creates a save point before every pacman or yay install/upgrade/remove. Runs as root via polkit.
settings.hook_flatpak_note: Wraps the flatpak command in interactive shells to snapshot before install/update/remove. Requires a new shell session to take effect.
unsupported.title: ✨ Btrfs only
unsupported.desc:
Save points work only on the Btrfs filesystem.

Support for ext4 and other filesystems was removed because the backups were unstable: copying the whole system before every installation slowed pacman down a lot, and restores were unreliable.

Your root filesystem: {0}.
err.unsupported_fs: Not supported: root is {0}, Save Point works only on Btrfs
rollback.notice_body:
Equestria OS failed to reach the login screen {n} times in a row, so Save Point returned the system to the restore point from {date}.

The previous state was not deleted: it is kept on the disk next to the system as “…_old_…”. You can delete it if you no longer need it.
